# agentgateway_llm_models (Data Source)

Models the gateway serves, sorted by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every model the gateway serves, sorted by id.
data "agentgateway_llm_models" "all" {}

# Only the models whose id starts with a prefix. Model ids default to the name.
data "agentgateway_llm_models" "openai" {
  name_prefix = "openai-"
}

output "model_names" {
  value = [for model in data.agentgateway_llm_models.all.models : model.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only include models whose id (usually the name) starts with this prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the listing: `llm.model:<name_prefix>`.
- `models` (Attributes List) Models served by the gateway, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Label shown in the UI in place of `name`.
- `id` (String) Stable identity of the model entry.
- `model` (String) Upstream model id.
- `name` (String) Client-facing model name or wildcard match pattern.
- `provider` (String) Provider name, or the custom provider object as JSON.
- `visibility` (String) Whether clients may request the model directly (`public`) or only through a virtual model (`internal`).
